sources.title: Glacial Lake Atlas of Indian Himalayan River Basins
sources.scope: Indian Himalayan river basins: Indus, Ganga, and Brahmaputra
sources.interpretation_limit: This is a pinned inventory summary, not a row-level lake frame or event/control cohort.

sources.publisher: Central Water Commission (CWC), Ministry of Jal Shakti
sources.title: Monthly monitoring report of Glacial Lakes & Water Bodies
sources.scope: CWC monitored glacial lakes and water bodies; monitoring portfolio, not a complete national event census
sources.monitoring_method: Remote-sensing water-spread measurement with automatic processing and manual digitization where required
sources.interpretation_limit: Monitoring coverage and reported no-change cannot be treated as verified non-event histories without lake-level observation evidence.

limitations: Reported counts are not independent event counts.
No row-level inventory payload was acquired in this phase.
No source bytes are retained by this metadata-only registry; official URLs and scope claims are pinned for the next approved ingestion step.
No lake is classified as a verified non-event from absence in a catalog.
